c74object.name: evi_svfs
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_svfs.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_svfs.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_svfs.genexpr file also requires:
evi_svfs_tpt.genexpr
evi_svfs_lto.genexpr
evi_svfs_tpt_filters.genexpr
evi_svfs_lto_extras.genexpr
About this File:
This file requires all evieve linear SVFs code in one require. You will rarely need this catch-all and should look into the individual requires contained here as it is more efficient to include subsets of GenExpr code. TPT SVF filters are superior to Biquads and you should always consider using these filters where possible. The linear SVFs in evieve provide a wide range of filter types with excellent modulation properties and very efficient operation.
